name: Azel
source:
Favorite food: Ramen (also cup noodles)
Disliked food: Spaghetti (because it's so hard to eat)
Hobbies: Camera
Skills: Taking pictures, being patient

2nd-year student who transferred into [url=/c3392]Shin's[/url] class. Azel is a very quiet girl and has a cold attitude towards others. She does not participate in any school activities, and like Shin, comes from a poor family. Has an interest in photography. Like [url=/c3405]Lolotte[/url] and [url=/c5295]Amyrina[/url], she is also an angel. She is also a boss character in the 1st game and later playable in the PSP version.

Azel has impressive stats, scoring above-average in all fields except support, which is her strongest stat. The only ones who can compete with her are Shin's maou form (which loses out to her in terms of support), Macaron (who pretty much ties in all fields), and Bylous (who beats her in terms of power, but Bylous still has crap support). Azel uses light attacks similar to [url=/c3804]Ria's[/url], but which are far more powerful in terms of defense, making her the ultimate defensive support character. Her title is "Reveal Author".
